case_title: Amrutlal Liladharbhai Kotak & Ors. v. State of Gujarat
trial_court_outcome: Convicted under Sections 304-B and 498-A of the IPC
neutral_facts: The accused, who were the husband and relatives of the husband of the deceased, were involved in a case where the deceased committed suicide. The deceased was married to one of the accused, and after the marriage, she was subjected to mental torture and harassment due to insufficient dowry. The deceased's father received a call informing him of the incident and arrived at the scene. The police registered a complaint against the accused, and the accused were arrested. During the trial, several witnesses testified about the mental torture and harassment the deceased faced. The trial court convicted the accused under Sections 304-B and 498-A of the IPC. The High Court upheld the conviction, and the Supreme Court dismissed the appeal, affirming the conviction.
